description.value: Elevated Pizza Co is an artisan pizza shop situated inside the District 1881 development in Chilliwack, offering 12" and 16" pies, panuozzo sandwiches, focaccia bites, and drinks. The menu leans toward elevated ingredients — nduja sausage, goat cheese, smoked scamorza, balsamic reduction — making it a step above typical fast-food pizza. Online ordering supports both pickup and delivery, and the shop operates seven days a week.
